inspections_note: Hawaii DOH inspects every food establishment and posts a green, yellow or red placard (HAR 11-50); results are looked up one place at a time on DOH's site. No bulk data is published, so none is shown here.
lahaina_note: Listings inside Lahaina's Census place are shown only when a 2025-26 source shows them open (Aug 8, 2023 wildfire).
